dedupe_keys.name: idaes generation and transmission expansion planning

description: IDAES-GTEP is a Pyomo-based generation and transmission expansion-planning model from the IDAES developers. Its generalised disjunctive programming formulation separates investment stages, commitment periods and dispatch decisions. Users load Prescient-formatted network data and cost assumptions, configure model options in Python or TOML, apply transformations and call a solver. Documented outputs include JSON and CSV results and plots. Coverage, planning horizon and temporal aggregation are configurable; the repository supplies benchmark examples, not a complete observed grid inventory. Public source and installation instructions are free under the IDAES BSD-style licence with its stated enhancement clause. Solvers have their own terms, with HiGHS and Gurobi named in the examples. Documentation lists errors or missing data in several legacy drivers, so the presence of an example does not establish that every supplied case runs. The model supports capacity expansion and operating-cost studies comparable in purpose to PyPSA (model-pypsa). The first review's generic IDAES process-platform records do not name this separate power-infrastructure planning model. No optimisation was executed here.
